visualization.name: Markdown Viewer
visualization.description: Read Markdown documents as formatted text
visualization.help:
# What is the Markdown Viewer?
The Markdown Viewer shows a `markdown` dataset as formatted text, with headings, lists, tables, links and code blocks, using **markdown-it**.
## Key Features
- **CommonMark**: Renders standard Markdown plus tables and strikethrough, and turns plain URLs into links. - **Safe**: Raw HTML in the dataset is shown as text, and the output is sanitised with DOMPurify, so a dataset cannot run scripts. - **Large files**: Datasets above 1 MB show their first megabyte, with a notice.
To learn more about markdown-it, visit: [https://github.com/markdown-it/markdown-it](https://github.com/markdown-it/markdown-it)
